nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Library root: declares 7 modules (files, install, manager, network, oxp, releases, ui), defines ManagerPlugin struct and ManageTool, implements oxiguitar_plugin::{Tool, Plugin} traits, exports ID and TOOL constants.

nodes.name: manager.rs
nodes.summary: Core state machine: Copy, State, LineData, Shared structs with methods. Handles window open, file network analysis, GitHub release queries, add/delete/update operations. Contains 4 tests for update_folder placement, copy grouping, update display, and state mutations.

nodes.name: files.rs
nodes.summary: Plugin file entries: Entry struct representing a plugin file as shown in the UI. Converts Host::plugin_files output to display entries, determines deletability based on folder kind and writability. Contains newest_installed helper and 3 tests.

nodes.name: install.rs
nodes.summary: File operations: safe write (write to .part then rename), delete with Windows fallback (.old rename), clean for unfinished files, SHA256 checksum verification, zip unpacking with manifest matching, installed_name for release file naming. Uses tar, sha2, zip crates.

nodes.name: network.rs
nodes.summary: Network detection via import table analysis: reads plugin .oxp library slice, checks for network calls (socket, connect, getaddrinfo, WSASocket, WSAConnect, GetAddrInfo) and network libraries (winhttp.dll, wininet.dll, Network.framework, CFNetwork). Handles Mach-O universal binaries. Uses object crate.

nodes.name: oxp.rs
nodes.summary: Plugin archive parsing: extracts manifest.json and library (plugin.so/dll/dylib) as byte slices from uncompressed tar archive. Validates order (manifest first, library second), checks for old bare-library format. Uses tar and object crates.

nodes.name: releases.rs
nodes.summary: GitHub release checking: Repo struct (owner/name), Release struct (version, zip, sums), Found enum (Release/Nothing/Failed), Checker with ureq agent and ETag cache. Parses GitHub API JSON, filters by target platform, handles rate limiting (60/hr). Uses semver, serde_json, ureq.

nodes.name: ui.rs
nodes.summary: Slint UI integration: ManagerUi struct manages two views (manager window, confirm dialog). Implements oxiguitar_plugin::Ui trait with callbacks (add, remove, update, close, confirmed, cancelled). Runs file analysis, GitHub queries, file dialog, and updates on plugin threads. Uses rfd for file picker.

nodes.name: manager.slint
nodes.summary: Slint UI definition: Line struct (name, version, path, removable, update), RemoveButton component (24px red X with tooltip), ManagerWindow (Add button, ListView, status text, Close button), ConfirmDialog (name/path, Delete/Cancel buttons).

nodes.name: contract.rs
nodes.summary: Plugin contract tests: builds .oxp file, checks through OxiGuitar's plugin host, verifies manifest parsing and network detection, tests plugin discovery in user folder. Uses oxiguitar_plugin_test and oxiguitar_host crates.

nodes.name: test-all.py
nodes.summary: Test runner (1393 lines): builds workspace, runs cargo test, executes suite.json stages, tests corpus files through OxiGuitar core, checks feature coverage, writes summary.md + log + corpus JSON. Supports plugin contract testing against newest core release.

nodes.name: ManagerPlugin
nodes.summary: The plugin entry point. Holds ManageTool (for the 'manage' tool) and Ui (Slint UI wrapper). Created by start() which initializes Shared with Host and ManagerUi, then wraps ManagerUi in Arc for both tool and UI.

nodes.name: ManageTool
nodes.summary: Wraps Arc<ManagerUi>. Implements Tool trait: run() calls ManagerUi::open() to launch the plugin manager window.

nodes.name: Copy
nodes.summary: A plugin file copy in the list. Holds an Entry (file metadata) and a network boolean (whether it can reach the network).

nodes.name: State
nodes.summary: UI state: generation counter (for session isolation), user_folder path, copies list, latest releases cache (HashMap<Repo, Found>), busy flag, status message. Methods: update_for(), lines(), put().

nodes.name: LineData
nodes.summary: Display line: name (with '! ' prefix if network), version, path, removable flag, update version (shown only on first copy of each plugin).

nodes.name: Shared
nodes.summary: Thread-safe shared state: Host reference, Checker for GitHub queries, Mutex<State>. Methods: new(), state(), open(), change(), closed(), look_at_files(), ask(), add(), delete(), start_update(), update().

nodes.name: Entry
nodes.summary: Plugin file entry: path, folder kind, id, name, version, homepage, state, deletable flag. Methods: of() (from PluginFile), used(), folder_text(), state_text().

nodes.name: Parts
nodes.summary: Plugin archive parts: manifest byte slice (manifest.json) and library byte slice (plugin.so/dll/dylib). Returned by parts() function.

nodes.name: Repo
nodes.summary: GitHub repository: owner and name strings. Implements Display, PartialEq, Eq, Hash. Parsed from homepage URLs via repo_of().

nodes.name: Release
nodes.summary: A GitHub release with a file for this system: version (semver), zip_name, zip URL, optional SHA256SUMS URL.

nodes.name: Found
nodes.summary: Check result: Release(Release) for a found release, Nothing for no matching release, Failed(String) for errors (network, rate limit, 404).

nodes.name: Checker
nodes.summary: GitHub API client: ureq agent (60s timeout, custom user agent), Mutex<HashMap<Repo, (etag, json)>> cache. Methods: new(), check(), releases(), download(). Handles 304 Not Modified, 404, rate limiting.

nodes.name: ManagerUi
nodes.summary: UI controller: Host, Arc<Shared>, Mutex<Option<PathBuf>> for delete confirmation. Methods: new(), open() (launches window + background threads), push() (updates UI properties), add() (file dialog), ask_to_remove(), answered(), update().

nodes.name: Ui
nodes.summary: Wraps Arc<ManagerUi>. Implements oxiguitar_plugin::Ui trait: callback() dispatches to ManagerUi methods (add, remove, update, close, confirmed, cancelled), shown(), closed().

nodes.name: State::update_for
nodes.summary: Returns the newest release for a plugin id when it is newer than every installed copy. Uses repo() to find the GitHub repo, checks latest cache, compares versions via semver.

nodes.name: State::lines
nodes.summary: Produces Vec<LineData> from copies: adds '! ' prefix for network files, shows update version only on first copy of each plugin, sets removable flag from entry.deletable.

nodes.name: State::put
nodes.summary: Inserts a copy into the list: replaces existing at same path, or inserts after the last copy of the same plugin id, or appends at the end.

nodes.name: Shared::open
nodes.summary: Called when window opens: gets plugin files from Host, cleans user folder of unfinished files, builds grouped copies, extracts repos to check, increments generation counter. Returns (generation, paths, repos) for background work.

nodes.name: Shared::change
nodes.summary: Applies a mutation to State only if the generation matches (prevents stale updates from closed windows). Returns whether the change was applied.

nodes.name: Shared::look_at_files
nodes.summary: Background work: reads each file's imports via network::file_uses_network(), marks copies with network capability. Runs off the UI thread.

nodes.name: Shared::ask
nodes.summary: Background work: checks a single repo via Checker::check(), stores result in latest cache. Sets status message on failure.

nodes.name: Shared::add
nodes.summary: Copies a plugin file into the user's folder via install::install_file(), checks network capability, creates a new Entry, updates status message.

nodes.name: Shared::delete
nodes.summary: Deletes a copy at a path (after confirming deletable). Calls install::delete(), removes from copies list, updates status.

nodes.name: Shared::update
nodes.summary: Background work: downloads release zip, verifies checksum, unpacks matching plugin files, installs to appropriate folder (replacing old copies if writable, or user folder if not). Updates status with result.

nodes.name: update_folder
nodes.summary: Determines where an update goes: the folder of the used copy if writable, or the user folder. Returns (folder, kept_path) where kept_path is the old copy that stays in use (for AppImage/macOS app cases).

nodes.name: grouped
nodes.summary: Sorts copies so that copies of the same plugin are adjacent, plugins in the order first found. Copies without an id are interleaved at their first appearance.

nodes.name: Entry::of
nodes.summary: Converts a PluginFile from Host into an Entry. Parses version via semver, determines deletability from folder kind and writability, falls back to filename for name.

nodes.name: may_delete
nodes.summary: Whether a copy in a folder of a given kind may be deleted: always true for User/Listed, false for System, false for Program on macOS (app signature protection).

nodes.name: folder_writable
nodes.summary: Tests writability by creating and removing a probe file (.oxiguitar-plugin-manager-{pid}). Distinguishes portable folders from read-only mounts (AppImage) and package folders.

nodes.name: newest_installed
nodes.summary: Finds the newest semver version among all copies of a plugin id.

nodes.name: manifest_of
nodes.summary: Parses manifest.json from plugin file data via oxp::parts(). Returns a Manifest struct or error.

nodes.name: replace
nodes.summary: Safe file replacement: writes to .part file, syncs, then renames. On Windows, renames existing loaded file to .old before replacing (since Windows won't allow replacing a loaded library). Cleans up on error.

nodes.name: delete
nodes.summary: Deletes a file. On Windows, if the file is loaded (can't be removed), renames to .old for later cleanup. NotFound errors are treated as success.

nodes.name: clean
nodes.summary: Removes .oxp.part (unfinished writes) and .oxp.old (replaced copies) from a folder.

nodes.name: install_file
nodes.summary: Validates .oxp extension, reads file, parses manifest, copies to target folder via replace(). Returns (target_path, manifest).

nodes.name: check_sum
nodes.summary: Verifies downloaded data against SHA256SUMS file from a release. Parses SUMS format (hash + whitespace + filename), computes SHA256 of data, compares.

nodes.name: unpack
nodes.summary: Extracts plugin files from a release zip: reads each .oxp member, checks size against DOWNLOAD_MAX, parses manifest, matches plugin id. Returns (installed_name, data) pairs.

nodes.name: is_network_import
nodes.summary: Checks if a (library, name) pair is a network call: matches against 7 known calls (socket, connect, getaddrinfo, WSASocketW/A, WSAConnect, GetAddrInfoW) or 4 network libraries (winhttp.dll, wininet.dll, Network.framework, CFNetwork). Handles Mach-O underscore prefix.

nodes.name: uses_network
nodes.summary: Checks whether a plugin file's library imports network calls. Extracts library slice via oxp::parts(), delegates to library_uses_network().

nodes.name: file_uses_network
nodes.summary: Reads a plugin file from disk and checks if it uses the network. Entry point for network detection.

nodes.name: parts
nodes.summary: Extracts manifest.json and library from an uncompressed tar archive. Validates order (manifest first, library second), checks for old bare-library format, handles truncated files.

nodes.name: repo_of
nodes.summary: Parses a GitHub homepage URL into a Repo. Handles https://, www., trailing slash, .git suffix, query/hash fragments. Validates owner/name characters (alphanumeric, dash, underscore, dot).

nodes.name: newest
nodes.summary: Finds the newest release in a GitHub API JSON list that has a zip for the given target platform. Skips drafts, validates semver tags, finds matching asset and optional SHA256SUMS.

nodes.name: Checker::check
nodes.summary: Checks a single repo: calls releases() for JSON, then newest() to find the best release for this system. Wraps result in Found enum.

nodes.name: Checker::releases
nodes.summary: Fetches GitHub releases JSON with ETag caching. Handles 200 (cache update), 304 (not modified), 404 (not found), 403/429 (rate limit with reset time). 60-second timeout, DOWNLOAD_MAX size limit.

nodes.name: Checker::download
nodes.summary: Downloads a file (zip or SHA256SUMS) from a URL. 200 OK required, DOWNLOAD_MAX size limit.

nodes.name: ManagerUi::open
nodes.summary: Opens the plugin manager window: calls Shared::open() for initial data, shows the MANAGER view, spawns background thread for file network analysis (look_at_files) and parallel GitHub queries (ask) via thread::scope.

nodes.name: ManagerUi::add
nodes.summary: Shows a file dialog (rfd) to select a .oxp file. Spawns a thread: calls Shared::add() with the selected file, then pushes updated UI.

nodes.name: ManagerUi::ask_to_remove
nodes.summary: Shows the CONFIRM dialog for a line index. Sets name/path properties, stores the path in asking mutex, shows the dialog.

nodes.name: ManagerUi::update
nodes.summary: Starts an update: calls Shared::start_update() for (generation, id, release), spawns a thread for Shared::update(), pushes UI after completion.

nodes.name: Ui::callback
nodes.summary: Dispatches Slint callbacks to ManagerUi methods: add, remove (ask_to_remove), update, close, confirmed (answered true), cancelled (answered false).

nodes.name: Ui::closed
nodes.summary: Handles view closure: MANAGER closed increments generation (drops stale updates) and closes CONFIRM; CONFIRM closed clears the asking path.

nodes.name: files
nodes.summary: Module: converts Host::plugin_files output into UI entries. Determines deletability based on folder kind and writability. Provides Entry struct and helpers (may_delete, folder_writable, newest_installed).

nodes.name: install
nodes.summary: Module: safe file operations (atomic write via .part, Windows .old fallback), SHA256 verification, zip unpacking with manifest matching. Depends on oxp module for archive parsing.

nodes.name: manager
nodes.summary: Module: core state machine. Manages window state, copy grouping, update placement across system/user/program folders. Coordinates with files, network, releases, and install modules. Contains unit tests.

nodes.name: network
nodes.summary: Module: detects network capability by analyzing imported functions in plugin libraries. Supports ELF, Mach-O (including universal binaries), PE formats via the object crate.

nodes.name: oxp
nodes.summary: Module: parses OxiGuitar plugin archive format (uncompressed tar with manifest.json + library). Used by install and network modules.

nodes.name: releases
nodes.summary: Module: queries GitHub API for newest releases. ETag caching, rate limit handling, platform-specific target matching. Uses semver for version comparison, serde_json for parsing, ureq for HTTP.

nodes.name: ui
nodes.summary: Module: Slint UI integration. Manages two views (manager window, confirm dialog). Runs background work on plugin threads. Uses rfd for file dialogs. Depends on manager and files modules.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Entry point: parses CLI args (--corpus, --release, --core, --features-only, etc.), sets up environment, loads suite.json, runs stages in order (build, list, test, extra stages, features check, core tests, corpus tests), writes summary.

nodes.name: Cargo::build
nodes.summary: Class method: runs cargo test --no-run, parses JSON compiler messages to discover test binaries and their package/target info.

nodes.name: Cargo::run
nodes.summary: Class method: runs cargo test --no-fail-fast, parses test results line by line, tracks failures and crashes, returns results dict, failures dict, and crash list.

nodes.name: prepare_core
nodes.summary: Fetches and builds the OxiGuitar core: clones the newest release (or uses --core DIR), builds oxiguitar-cli and oxiguitar-plugin-test. Caches fetched releases in XDG cache directory.

nodes.name: corpus_through_core
nodes.summary: Tests corpus files through the core's oxiguitar-cli: detects file type, runs info, converts through format plugins, verifies lossless round-trip (3 trips). Writes corpus-*.json reports.

nodes.name: write_summary
nodes.summary: Writes target/test-all/<time>/summary.md: result table, environment info, stage results, failed tests with output, plugin contract failures, corpus results, features coverage, reporting instructions.

nodes.name: Out
nodes.summary: Output class: terminal (with progress bar) and log file. Methods: stamp(), logline(), section(), say(), progress(), end_progress(), close(). Thread-safe via lock.

nodes.name: Cargo
nodes.summary: Cargo wrapper class: manages cargo test commands, discovers binaries, lists tests, runs tests with result parsing. Tracks package info, test args, locked mode.

nodes.name: dependabot.yml
nodes.summary: Dependabot configuration: checks for Rust dependency updates weekly, groups minor/patch updates.

nodes.name: pull_request_template.md
nodes.summary: PR template: checklist for PRs including test results, documentation updates, changelog entry, and linking to related issues.

nodes.name: book.toml
nodes.summary: mdBook configuration: title Plugin Manager, author Mateus Rocha de Paula, description for search engines, source directory src, output directory ../book.

nodes.name: apt-install.sh
nodes.summary: Debian/Ubuntu dependency installer: installs Rust toolchain, Slint dependencies, build tools (build-essential, pkg-config, libssl-dev, libgtk-3-dev).

nodes.name: check-dco.sh
nodes.summary: DCO (Developer Certificate of Origin) checker: verifies that all commits in a PR have a valid sign-off line. Used by CI DCO job.

nodes.name: suite.json
nodes.summary: Test suite definition: lists stages (build, test, features, contract), corpus configuration, plugin build definitions, and platform/architecture filters.
